description: Grubhub restaurants delivering to a US ZIP code (or lat/lng), optionally matching a search such as pizza or sushi: restaurant id, name, cuisines, rating and rating count, price level (1-4), delivery fee and order minimum (USD), delivery time window (minutes), pickup/delivery, open now, phone, address, distance (miles) and Grubhub link. Up to 20 per page. From Grubhub's own diner API through a US proxy. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: Optional search text: cuisine, dish or restaurant name, e.g. pizza

zip.description: US 5-digit ZIP code, e.g. 10001 (or give lat and lng)
